question: Akham Lakshmi Devi was honoured with Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for the year 2018 for her contribution to _________ dance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Akham Lakshmi Devi was honoured with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for the year 2018 for her contribution to **Manipuri** dance.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award is the highest Indian recognition given to practicing
